metadata.title: Curry Function
metadata.description: Transforms functions to enable partial application, converting multi-argument functions into sequences of single-argument functions
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(n) where n is argument count

metadata.title: Debounce Function
metadata.description: Delays function execution until a specified wait time has elapsed since the last call, optimizing performance for frequent events

metadata.title: DeepClone Function
metadata.description: Creates deep copies of objects and arrays handling nested structures, circular references, and various JavaScript types
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is total properties/elements
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(d) where d is maximum depth

metadata.title: DeepEqual Function
metadata.description: Performs deep equality comparison between values, handling nested structures, various data types, and circular references
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is total properties/elements
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(d) where d is maximum depth

metadata.title: GroupBy Function
metadata.description: Groups array items by a key selector function or property name
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is array length

metadata.title: IsEmpty Function
metadata.description: Comprehensive emptiness checking for all JavaScript data types including objects, arrays, strings, and collections
metadata.timeComplexity: O(1) for most types, O(n) for objects

metadata.title: IsValidEmail Function
metadata.description: Comprehensive email validation with multiple validation strategies from basic to RFC-compliant patterns
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is email length

metadata.title: IsValidURL Function
metadata.description: Comprehensive URL validation with multiple strategies including native URL API and regex patterns
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is URL length

metadata.title: Memoize Function
metadata.description: Caches function results to avoid expensive recalculations, improving performance for pure functions with predictable inputs
metadata.timeComplexity: O(1) for cache hits, O(f) for new calculations
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(n) where n is unique argument combinations

metadata.title: Omit Function
metadata.description: Creates new objects by excluding specified properties, supporting various filtering strategies including nested paths and predicates
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is source object properties
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(k) where k is result object properties

metadata.title: Pick Function
metadata.description: Creates new objects by selecting only specified properties from source objects
metadata.timeComplexity: O(k) where k is number of keys to pick
metadata.spaceComplexity: O(k) where k is result object properties

metadata.title: Retry Function
metadata.description: Automatically retries failed operations with configurable backoff strategies, essential for handling unreliable network operations
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is retry attempts

metadata.title: Slugify Function
metadata.description: Converts strings to URL-friendly slugs by removing special characters and replacing spaces
metadata.timeComplexity: O(n) where n is string length

metadata.title: Throttle Function
metadata.description: Limits function execution to at most once per specified time period, ensuring regular execution during continuous events
